article: For each question, write the correct answer. My city by Harry Salter Do you live in a nice place? I do! The city (27)…………… I live is called Bristol, and it's in the south-west of England. It's not very big, but there are loads of things for teenagers to do here.  (28)…………… you’re interested in television, you should go to the Bristol TV and Radio Studios. On the tour of the studios, you can have a go at presenting and appear (29)…………… your own radio drama.  Or if you’re into sport, why (30)…………… try rowing? The best place is a very pretty local section of the Kennet and Avon canal. It connects Bristol to London and it (31)…………… built in the early 18th century, so you can experience some local history at the same time.  These are just two (32)…………… of the things you can do here. It really is a great place.

explanations.27:
原因：定语从句，“我居住的城市”，where 作地点状语。
语法点：先行词表地点，用 where，如 The city where I live is beautiful.
explanations.28:
原因：条件句引导词，“如果你对电视感兴趣”。
语法点：if 引导条件句，如 If you like it, take it.
explanations.29:
原因：“appear in your own radio drama”，“出现在广播剧中”。
词汇点：appear in + 地点 / 活动，如 appear in a movie（出演电影）。
explanations.30:
原因：“why not + 动词原形” 表建议，“为什么不尝试划船”。
语法点：why not do，如 Why not try again?
explanations.31:
原因：一般过去时被动语态，“运河建于 18 世纪”。
语法点：be done 表被动，如 The house was built in 2000.
explanations.32:
原因：“two examples of...”，“两个…… 的例子”。
词汇点：example of sth.，如 an example of good behavior（良好行为的例子）。
